claims.sourceText: Named-source reporting summarised at Garber Files, 'From Mirage Men to Military Deception'
claims.text: Air Force OSI personnel supplied Paul Bennewitz with fabricated documents concerning alien activity in the early 1980s; the episode is the documented core of the 'Mirage Men' account of UFO-adjacent counterintelligence deception.

edges.label: The Bennewitz method and the alleged YANKEE BLUE practice are the same technique at different scale
edges.note: Doty's documented AFOSI activity - feeding fabricated alien-technology material to a target to protect classified programmes - is the same technique Yankee Blue applied internally to cleared personnel. The inference is about method, not about Doty's involvement in Yankee Blue.

edges.note: Yankee Blue sits in the same documented Air Force practice of manufacturing UFO belief for security purposes as the Kirtland AFB/AFOSI operations against Paul Bennewitz. The connection is thematic and institutional; no released document ties Yankee Blue administratively to Kirtland.
